{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Internet Tax Freedom Act put a three-year moratorium on new Internet taxes to ensure that electronic commerce would not be smothered in its infancy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"An expanded visa program (H1-B) provided much of the highly skilled labor that makes rapid technological progress possible.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Securities Litigation Reform Act, enacted by overriding a veto, is preventing trial lawyers from preying on new cutting-edge companies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The threat of abusive lawsuits must not be allowed to cripple the capital formation that will drive the Information Revolution.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A codified World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) agreement ensured that content providers are protected from foreign criminals.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The extended research and development tax credit allows companies to innovate, when innovation is the name of the high tech game.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Deregulation of telecommunications, still in its early stages, shattered monopolies and opened the door to worldwide communication.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"These initiatives are grounded in a steadfast commitment to open markets.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"These initiatives are grounded in a steadfast commitment to minimal regulations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"These initiatives are grounded in a steadfast commitment to reducing taxes that snuff out innovation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"A landmark commercial law grants electronic signatures used in the formation of contracts online the same legal validity as pen and ink signatures on paper.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[8]},{"claim_text":"Business-to-business e-commerce will explode.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[8]},{"claim_text":"Paperwork costs will decline.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[8]},{"claim_text":"Convenience will increase.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[8]},{"claim_text":"Consumers rack up another major victory.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[8]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
